Messages.Body:
Say my tremere whacks a vampire with 1 blood for 1 damage with the
Sword of Nuln.

Does the vampire burn 1 blood, can't burn a 2nd to heal the damage, so
then goes to torpor with no blood

or

does it not burn any blood, as it can't burn 2 blood to heal the
damage, and thus goes to torpor with 1 blood?

thanks,
